title: Ollama server
text: Ollama serves models over HTTP on port 11434 by default; set OLLAMA_HOST to change the bind address.

title: Evidently license
text: Evidently is an open-source library released under the Apache-2.0 license.

title: Llama 3.2 1B
text: Llama 3.2 1B is a small instruction-tuned model with a 128K-token context window, small enough for CPU inference.

title: Evidently UI
text: Run `evidently ui --workspace ./workspace` to browse projects, dashboards, prompts and traces locally on port 8000.

title: Prompt versions
text: Every change to a prompt should be stored as a new version together with the evaluation feedback it received.
